partner_result_applied.applied_scope: conditional density of a translated original-coordinate square remains bounded under conditioning on a residual function

second_dependency.applied_scope: rank-two Brascamp-Lieb plus sharp Hausdorff-Young gives the borderline characteristic-function bound |phi(t)|<=pi B |det M|^-1/2 |t|^-1 when all residual row leverages are <=1/2

new_result.summary: For rank-exactly-three A=U Lambda U^T, a physical pivot row u with c=||u||^2 and a=u^T Lambda u !=0 leaves an exact orthogonal rank-two Schur frame W M2 W^T with |a||det M2|=c|det Lambda|. If the residual frame has max row leverage<=1/2, a new fractional square-smoothing lemma turns the rank-two |t|^-1 bound into ||p_Q||inf<=4 sqrt(B(W))/(c|det Lambda||a|)^(1/4). With c>1/2, |a|>=delta and three eigenvalues magnitude>=1 this is <=4 sqrt(e)(2/delta)^(1/4).

unresolved_implication: Close the localized rank-three branch in which heavy physical rows have near-zero Rayleigh pivot a, or the exact residual two-dimensional Schur frame still contains a row leverage>1/2, without invoking the refuted universal single-Schur-rank-two extraction.
next_step: Use a second product-preserving heavy-row/high-cardinality extraction on the residual frame, or exploit a^2+||b||^2=||Lambda u||^2 and hence quantitatively large physical off-diagonal coupling when |a| is small.
